title: Applicability of chapter 91.
bodyText: The board shall, in the administration of this chapter, conform to the provisions of chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §149A-53  Applicability of chapter 91.  The board shall, in the administration of this chapter, conform to the provisions of chapter 91. [L 1972, c 58, pt of §1; HRS §149A-43; ren L 1975, c 126, pt of §1]
